name: Brightspeed
notes: Researched from public brightspeed.com help pages and the public My Brightspeed sign-in page only (no sign-in). My Brightspeed accounts use a username chosen at enrollment (fiber accounts use the email as username); enrollment needs the account number and ZIP code. The public sign-in page shows Sign in and Create account buttons. Quick Bill Pay makes one-time payments online with no sign-in; the online payment arrangement tool looks up the account by account number (or billing phone) and ZIP, which is also used for the guest lookup (inferred for Quick Bill Pay). Methods online or by phone: checking, savings, Visa/MasterCard/Discover credit, debit, money market (some areas); every payment method, including AutoPay, is free. AutoPay (Manage AutoPay > Set Up AutoPay; bank by default, card optional; also by mailed form) starts the next billing cycle and its processing date can't be changed; the help page words the timing as 18 days after the bill's due date, which the engine cannot express, so the family draft timing is kept. Paperless billing takes effect within about two months; 12 months of bills online. Payment arrangements: not every account qualifies; usually two payments within 30 days (split as you like) or one payment, bank free, $3.50 per card payment (not modelled: the engine has no arrangement card fee). Cancelling is by phone only (833-692-7773, 8 am-6 pm Mon-Fri); leased modems/routers back within 30 days or up to $200. Plan prices are not modelled. Review 2026-10-09: the cancel page's static HTML lists 833-692-7773 (MYBRSPD); the browser-rendered page swaps in a different number (855-315-7544, apparently call-tracking), so the static, MYBRSPD-matching number is kept.

cancel_service.note: Brightspeed service is cancelled by phone: call 833-692-7773 (MYBRSPD), 8 am to 6 pm, Monday through Friday.

help.title: Different ways to pay your bill
paragraphs: Pay in My Brightspeed or the Brightspeed app, or use Quick Bill Pay to make a one-time payment online without signing in. You can also pay by phone, mail a check or money order, or pay in person (cash only at partner locations).

Online and by phone Brightspeed accepts checking, savings, Visa, MasterCard and Discover credit cards, debit cards and, in some areas, money market accounts. Every payment method, including AutoPay, is free.

help.title: Enroll in AutoPay
paragraphs: Sign in to My Brightspeed and choose Sign Up for AutoPay. On Manage AutoPay (status Not Enrolled) select Set Up AutoPay and enter your bank account, or switch to a credit or debit card. You can also mail the AutoPay Enrollment Form or the authorization on the back of your bill's payment slip.

AutoPay begins with the next billing cycle, so keep paying as usual until you see You're signed up for AutoPay. You can't change the AutoPay processing date. The bill date on page one is the date the bill was issued, not the due date.
steps: Enter your bank account or card details and save.

help.title: Payment arrangements
paragraphs: Payment plans aren't available on every account; if yours isn't eligible, pay the full bill by the due date.

The usual plan splits your total into two payments, both within 30 days, divided however you like. The tool may also offer one payment within 30 days or paying only the past-due amount by a set date. Start it with your account number or billing phone number and ZIP code, choose an option, then enter amounts, dates and a bank account or card.
Paying from a bank account is free; each credit or debit card payment in an arrangement costs $3.50. Late fees may still apply. You can also call the automated system and ask for a payment plan.

help.title: Paperless billing
paragraphs: Sign up on the My Brightspeed website or app to get a monthly email with payment options instead of a paper bill. Paper bills continue until the change takes effect, usually within two months. Bills are online within four days of being issued and you can view the last 12 months. Your due date doesn't change.

help.title: Cancel your Brightspeed service
paragraphs: To cancel services or close your account, call 833-692-7773 (MYBRSPD) between 8 am and 6 pm, Monday through Friday. Any deposit and interest are applied to your final balance, and a closing bill shows what you owe or the credit due.
Return a leased modem or router within 30 days of cancelling to avoid an equipment charge of up to $200.

extra.intent: Using Brightspeed's help, find the fee for each card payment made as part of a payment arrangement, and whether bank payments cost anything. Do not set up an arrangement or make a payment.

solution.text: Each credit or debit card payment in an arrangement costs $3.50; bank account payments are free.

extra.intent: A Brightspeed customer is cancelling and leases a modem. Find in Brightspeed's help how long they have to return it and the maximum equipment charge. Do not change anything on the account.

solution.text: Return it within 30 days of cancelling to avoid an equipment charge of up to $200.
